notes: The בְּ has taken its own *on*, so the second temporal word answers to the construct relation and goes to the infinitive as nomen rectum, following rule 52's closing sentence and its `בְּיוֹם הֵעָשׂוֹתוֹ` example.

The appositional *even* before *the tent of the testimony* is licensed by the לְ standing on that very phrase, so it is aligned rather than added; rule 16's added case is a word standing before a phrase no morpheme marks.
*as it were* is one rendering of the comparative כְּ under rule 30, headed on *as*; no other morpheme owns a part of it, the main clause's copula having already gone to יִהְיֶה.
The article of בָעֶרֶב is unrepresented, the ASV writing *at even* with no *the*.
